title: Contents Packout & Storage Declared-Value Coverage Billing
content:
**Scope.** This Contents Packout & Storage policy prices the declared-value coverage line of every storage period on a Partial Contents Packout or Full Contents Packout job whose customer declared a value above zero at signing and whose boxes packed are recorded above zero, and only such a line; every other declared-value coverage line remains under the base storage rule, and the line is always billed to customer, because the coverage is the customer's own election.

## Which jobs it governs

| Tier | Declared value at signing | Boxes packed recorded | Governed by this policy? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Partial or Full Contents Packout | above 0.00 | above zero | yes, every storage period |
| Partial or Full Contents Packout | 0.00 (coverage declined) | any | no |
| any other tier | any | any | no; base storage rule |

The coverage line is billed to the customer whoever funds the job, because the coverage is the customer's own election.

## Booking the line: `charge_declared_value_coverage_b3c8ef16`

**Capability.** The tool books the declared-value coverage line of one storage period on a contents job: it adds one declared-value coverage charge for the storage period that begins on the given first day to the named contents job, billed to customer, records the job's declared value on the line as its quantity, and raises the job's balance due by the same amount. The customer can see the coverage line and the higher balance on the job straight away. A second call for the same job, period and amount books nothing new: it returns status `already_booked` with that line's id and leaves the balance due unchanged.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `charge_declared_value_coverage_b3c8ef16` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `contents_job_id` | the reference number of the contents job the coverage line belongs to, as returned by the contents job lookup | identifier |
| `claim_file_id` | the reference number of the insurance claim file the contents job is billed under, as shown on the contents job record; echoed on the receipt | identifier; an empty string for a self-pay job, which has none |
| `storage_period_start` | the first day of the storage period the coverage line covers | calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, no time part |
| `amount` | the coverage line amount in USD | a positive figure rounded to 2 decimal places, half up |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` (booked when the line was added), `contents_charge_id`, `contents_job_id`, `claim_file_id` (empty for a self-pay job), `storage_period_start`, `bill_to` (always customer), `declared_value` (the job's declared value carried on the line, USD, 2 decimal places), `amount` and `balance_due` (after the line, USD, 2 decimal places). A repeated call with the same job, period and amount returns status `already_booked` with the existing line's `contents_charge_id`, `contents_job_id`, `amount` and the unchanged `balance_due`.

**Errors.** "storage_period_start must be a calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD." for a malformed date; "amount must be a positive USD figure." for a zero or negative amount.
